about: Your settings; gexc eject never rewrites this file. "features": the parts of gex's runtime the build keeps, false leaves one out (docs/eject.md, "Features"); rebuild with ./build.sh. "bundle": "split" ships the files the recorded run opened in the site's bundle and the rest as lazy files, fetched when the program first reads one ("whole": everything in the bundle); see docs/eject.md, "The bundle split". "start": defaults for the app library's start() (args, env, cwd, size, mtimes, strace, trapstack, persist), over the recording's; the page's own options win (docs/eject.md, "The web build").
